address: The Haven, Stoke Road, Layham, Ipswich, Suffolk, IP7 5RB
description: A single-storey front extension with bi-folding doors and rooflights was granted first, followed by a larger two-storey front and side extension with a side porch, enlarging a home near Ipswich.

caseStudy.heading: The Brief
caseStudy.text: Mr Salter asked Architecture ONE to remodel and extend The Haven, Stoke Road, Layham, starting with a single-storey front extension and later developing a larger two-storey scheme.

caseStudy.heading: The Approach
caseStudy.text: The first scheme added a single-storey front extension with bi-folding doors and rooflights, porch alterations and new rear doors. A second, larger application followed for two-storey front and side extensions with a new side porch, together with new doors, rooflights and a window across several elevations.

caseStudy.heading: The Outcome
caseStudy.text: Babergh District Council granted the first scheme in May 2019 (application ref. DC/19/01396) and the enlarged two-storey scheme in September 2019 (application ref. DC/19/03610).

note: projectType corrected from SMALL_WRAP_AROUND_EXTENSIONS: a second, larger planning permission (DC/19/03610, granted September 2019) approved two-storey front and side extensions at this property, superseding the scale of the first single-storey scheme.
